links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level and reading ease) of LLM patient education responses about BCI
links.effect: For 12 of 13 questions, Gemini text required a significantly lower reading grade level than ChatGPT (p < 0.05) with higher reading ease, implying ChatGPT text was harder to read.
links.quote: However, a clear significant disparity emerged in the dimension of readability: for 12 of the 13 questions, the text generated by Gemini required a significantly lower reading grade level than that of ChatGPT (p < 0.05) and had significantly higher reading ease scores.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the baseline accuracy, reliability, comprehensibility, and readability of ChatGPT and Gemini on patient education questions regarding brain-computer interfaces without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
